title: App Store screenshots S-V3: the Essembl theme, product-led
brief: Six App Store screenshots (iPhone 6.9", 1320 × 2868 PNG). The founder picked Essembl's store set on the reference board ("I liked the theme of this but don't do editorial for me"): its theme, product-led, no magazine layouts or model photography. A warm cream linen ground, huge tight two-tone headlines, Curate's own 3D phone tilted and running off the edge with the real build-284 screens, Emma's real wardrobe cut-outs in front with soft contact shadows, one idea each. 1 Today's look, already picked · 2 Your closet, from your photos · 3 See it on you, before you wear it · 4 Rain or shine, you're dressed · 5 Your stylist, one message away · 6 Your photos, your call.
hook: Screenshot 1, seen small in search: the Today screen on a tilted phone with the look's own blazer, skirt and boots on the linen in front, under 'Today's look, / already picked.'
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated.
The phone is Curate's own generic 3D model, not an iPhone.
